name: Graphic Packaging
outlook:
What Graphic Packaging says to expect

  • Full year 2026: net sales, adjusted EBITDA and adjusted EPSThe Company expects 2026 Net Sales, Adjusted EBITDA, and Adjusted EPS of approximately $8.6 billion, $1.05 billion, and $0.65, respectively.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted cash flow and capital spendingThe Company continues to expect 2026 Adjusted Cash Flow in the range of $600 million to $700 million, and 2026 capital spending below $450 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
